Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO acceptance SLA + early settlement option

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Auriga is excited to get Redwood set up as a vendor so we can start monthly billings for the integration work. Before we finalize the onboarding packet, two operational asks on our side:

1) PO acceptance timeline — our procurement team requires PO acknowledgement within 7 calendar days to reconcile delivery schedules. Can Redwood confirm the PO acceptance SLA (acknowledge/accept/reject) once a PO is issued? We typically see 3–5 business days from partners; Auriga needs the 7-day window locked for internal compliance.

2) Early settlement program — Auriga prefers Net 45 but would like to opt into an early settlement option on a subset of invoices. We can accept Net 15 payment in exchange for a 1.25% fee (per-invoice opt-in). Is Redwood open to an early-pay pilot (2–3 invoices to start) while we verify invoicing formats?

I've attached our W-9 and bank details for vendor setup (Auriga_W9.pdf, Auriga_Bank_Info.txt). Also attaching a sample Purchase Order we expect to receive so you can validate PO headers and required fields.

If helpful I can set up a short finance call (30 min) with our AP lead, Daniel. Next steps from Auriga: complete vendor portal registration, confirm PO header acceptance fields, and confirm whether early pay needs a separate addendum.

Thanks — look forward to your guidance on internal steps.

Best,
Alisha Verma
Head of Operations
Auriga Labs
attachments: Auriga_W9.pdf, Auriga_Bank_Info.txt

Hi Alisha — thanks for the clear note and for sending the W-9 and bank stub. Copying Marissa from Vendor Ops and David from Finance so we can align on both the PO SLA and the early-payment ask.

On the PO acknowledgement SLA: our standard flow is to acknowledge receipt within 3 business days and to formally accept (or flag exceptions) within 5 business days of PO transmission. We can confirm a 7-calendar-day acknowledgement window for Auriga in our onboarding if that is a strict requirement on your side; Marissa will update the intake checklist accordingly. Please confirm the exact PO headers your procurement team requires (PO number, bill-to, ship-to, remit-to, tax ID, contract ref).

On early settlement: this is handled by Finance and requires a simple addendum to the vendor terms; it can be invoice-by-invoice opt-in as you requested. David — can you confirm feasibility of Net 15 with a 1.25% fee and whether we need a minimum pilot length?

Action items for Auriga to unblock onboarding:
- Confirm tax ID and full legal entity name (matching W-9).
- Sign the vendor onboarding MAA we’ll send (I’ve attached the template).
- Register in our vendor portal (we’ll send invite once the vendor record is created).

Alisha — happy to set a 30-minute call this week with Marissa and David to finalize. Proposed times: Mon 10/11 10:00am PT or Tue 10/12 2:00pm PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Programs Manager

Hi Alisha / Priya — quick operational note from Vendor Ops: glad to accommodate the 7-calendar-day acknowledgement in the onboarding bundle for Auriga. A few items to call out so expectations are clear: 

• Standard PO processing: when a PO is received into our procurement queue (via procurement@redwood.com or EDI), we create the vendor PO record and attempt to acknowledge within 3 business days. If Auriga requires a 7-calendar-day formal acceptance window, we will set that on the vendor record; exceptions will be surfaced to procurement for resolution.

• Required PO header validation: Redwood requires PO number, invoice-to (legal entity), remit-to email, invoice contact phone, tax ID, and contract reference (if applicable). The sample PO Alisha included looks fine; we will test mapping in our intake environment during onboarding.

• Early settlement program (operational terms): Finance approval is required. If approved, we run early-pay through our payment platform where Auriga will opt individual invoices. Operational requirements: invoice submitted via vendor portal or AP portal email (ap-invoices@redwood.com), invoice must reference the accepted PO number, and remittance instructions must match our vendor record. Pilot parameters we typically use: 45–90 day minimum pilot, per-invoice opt-in allowed, processing fee between 1.25–1.75% depending on credit review. I’ve attached our early-pay term sheet (earlypay-term-sheet.pdf) for reference.

Next steps from Vendor Ops:
1) Priya will create vendor record once we receive completed onboarding packet and confirm tax ID.
2) Auriga to sign and return the MAA + onboarding checklist (MAA_Auriga_PO.pdf).
3) We will validate bank details via micro-deposit or vendor portal tokenization.
4) After vendor verification, Finance will confirm early-pay pricing and pilot start date.

Alisha — can you send the legal entity's formation state and the name exactly as it appears on the W-9? That will speed record creation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Hi team — finance here. We reviewed the request and can support an early settlement pilot for Auriga with the following guardrails: 

• Pricing: Net 15 option at a 1.25% fee per settled invoice (discount applied at payment).
• Pilot length: 60-day pilot covering up to 6 invoices total; we can extend after a review of invoice quality and turnaround time.
• Eligibility: vendor must complete the onboarding packet, pass vendor verification (bank micro-deposit or tokenization), and accept the early-pay addendum (DocuSign link below).
• Operational rules: invoices must include the Redwood PO number and be submitted via the vendor portal or ap-invoices@redwood.com. Any invoices not matching the PO will be rejected and routed back to vendor for remediation.

Priya / Marissa — please open the onboarding record and attach the signed W-9 and bank tokenization record. I’ve started a HubSpot deal for tracking (Deal: DL-2027-0043). Alisha — I’ll send the DocuSign addendum for signature; once countersigned, we’ll enable the early-pay flag in our payments platform.
